title: The Poisoned Chalice
logline: A paranoid heir suspects their trusted advisor is slowly poisoning them, and needs a pilot to intercept the advisor's yacht to find the antidote.

roles.description: Pale, sweating, convinced everyone is trying to kill them.
A beautiful but decaying space station belonging to a dying noble house.
A sleek, unassuming ship loaded with hidden weapons.
A crumbling dynasty desperate to hold onto power.

public_situation: The head of the {role:noble_house} recently died of a mysterious illness, leaving the {role:paranoid_heir} in charge of the {role:orbiting_manor}.
private_truth: The advisor killed the previous head and is now slowly poisoning the heir to seize full control of the house's assets.

beats.public_change: The heir suffers a sudden, public collapse during a meeting.

missions.reason: The heir begs the pilot to buy generic broad-spectrum antidotes and deliver them quietly to the manor.
missions.private_fact: The antidotes have no effect because the poison is a custom-engineered synthetic virus.

beats.public_change: The advisor publicly declares the manor safe and dismisses rumors of foul play.

missions.reason: The advisor hires the pilot to run a thorough scan of the manor's air filtration system to "prove" it is clean.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the filters have been deliberately bypassed.

beats.public_change: The advisor boards their yacht, preparing to leave the heir to die.

missions.reason: The heir pays the pilot to destroy the yacht and recover the advisor's medical safe, which contains the only antidote.
missions.private_fact: The yacht is heavily armed and escorted by mercenary drones.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the medical safe. The advisor's ship is destroyed.

options.label: Deliver the antidote to the heir
Keep the antidote and let the heir die

resolutions.summary: The heir takes the antidote and survives. They brutally purge the noble house of the advisor's loyalists, becoming a paranoid tyrant.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot saved a paranoid noble from assassination, unleashing a tyrant.

resolutions.summary: The heir succumbs to the poison. The noble house collapses into chaos, and its assets are seized by corporate creditors.
The advisor escapes. The heir dies, and the advisor returns to legally claim the entire estate.

loose_threads.detail: The synthetic virus was developed by a top-secret naval bioweapons lab.
The advisor was secretly working for a rival noble house looking to consolidate power.

radio_hooks: Health of {role:paranoid_heir} failing; {role:trusted_advisor} assumes interim control.

voice_direction.paranoid_heir: Shaky, very quiet, constantly looking around.
